function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, and the data dictionary states that `sample_seq` can be >1, meaning some patients were re-tested and appear in two rows. The row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient should be kept.", "implication": "If we do not deduplicate on `patient_id`, we will double-count patients who were re-tested, which biases the mean upward (or downward, depending on the re-test values). We must deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` per `patient_id` before computing any patient-level statistics."}
function.name: note_finding
